timezone.description: Timezone for the interview. Should always be IST (Indian Standard Time).

candidateName.description: Full name of the candidate as spoken/confirmed by them during the call. Must be their actual name (e.g., 'John Smith'), NOT their email address or phone number. Ask the candidate 'May I have your full name please?' and use their response.

candidateEmail.description: Email address of the candidate for sending interview confirmation. This will be provided to you.

interviewDate.description: Date of interview in YYYY-MM-DD format. Examples: 2026-02-25, 2026-02-26. Must be within next 2 days from today.

interviewTime.description: Time of interview in HH:MM AM/PM format. Examples: 02:30 PM, 10:00 AM, 04:15 PM. Always include AM or PM.

candidateConfirmed.description: Set to true ONLY if candidate explicitly confirmed the slot with words like 'yes', 'confirmed', 'okay', 'sure', 'perfect'. Set to false if candidate said 'maybe', 'I think so', or gave no clear confirmation.

irfId.description: The IRF ID for this interview request. This will be provided to you and must be included in every submission.
